verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that Jitsu runs its own MCP server for external agents to manage pipelines (jitsu-docs-19, jitsu-docs-63). That is the server role, and nothing documents Jitsu acting as an MCP client that connects to other MCP servers and uses their tools. Server-side evidence does not transfer to this client-side story, and a data platform could plausibly ship such a feature, so the axis applies and lack of evidence is 'none'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
